ph_voicetecx_line: Speak into any app on your Mac, in Taiwan Mandarin or English. Your voice and text never leave your Mac.
ph_voicetecx_p1: Built for Traditional Chinese and Taiwan's way of writing
ph_voicetecx_p2: Your voice and text stay on your Mac; no account needed
vt_body: VoiceTecx types what you say into any app on your Mac: Taiwan Mandarin in Traditional Chinese, English in English, or both in one sentence, with the punctuation already in place. It runs entirely on your Mac: no account, no subscription, nothing uploaded.
vt_f1_d: Press your shortcut, speak, and the text appears at your cursor. Tap to start and stop, or hold to talk.
vt_f2_d: Recognition trained on Taiwan Mandarin and on the Mandarin–English mixing of everyday work, plus our own rules for punctuation, sound-alike words and Taiwan's writing style.
vt_f3_d: Traditional characters, full-width punctuation in Chinese, Arabic numerals for money, dates and phone numbers, and English names spelled right.
vt_f4_d: Add names and product words once and they are heard correctly. Fix a mistake in History and VoiceTecx learns the fix.
vt_f5_d: Choose an audio file (mp3, wav, m4a…) and get a transcript with times, as text or subtitles (.srt).
vt_f6_d: Your voice and text stay on your Mac, with no account. Recordings are never kept, and each language file is checked against a fixed fingerprint when it is downloaded.
vt_n3: per sentence on an M5 MacBook Pro, 16 GB unified memory
vt_num_note: Character accuracy = 100 − character error rate; punctuation score = F1 of the marks. 25 Taiwan Mandarin sentences read by one speaker, MacBook Pro M5 16GB Unified Memory, on battery in Low Power Mode, November 2026; on power VoiceTecx takes about 1.2 s. Apple recognises while you speak, so its text is ready almost at once; VoiceTecx recognises after you stop, and in return makes fewer mistakes and writes full punctuation. More speakers will be added.
vt_status: Public beta · Mac with Apple silicon
vt_n3_cmp: Engine time, from recording to text
vt_price_hint: Pay once from NT$1,490 · early-bird price NT$499
vt_num_lead: The same 25 Taiwan Mandarin sentences, read into VoiceTecx, the original MediaTek and OpenAI models, and Apple's two recognisers. All of them run offline on the Mac.
vt_aud_title: Made for people who write all day
vt_a1_d: Client matters can't go to the cloud. Draft memos and emails by voice, entirely on your Mac.
vt_a2_d: Notes between appointments, and nothing leaves the room.
vt_a3_d: Answer LINE and email at speaking speed, with the English you really use: deadline, PowerPoint.
vt_a4_d: Drafts, scripts and subtitles: speak freely and get clean Traditional Chinese, punctuated.
vt_price_lead: No subscription and no account. A licence covers VoiceTecx 1 and all its 1.x updates. Try it free first: unlimited for 7 days, then 30 minutes of speech a month.
vt_req: Made exclusively for Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later), on macOS 14 or later, with 16 GB of memory or more.
vt_p1_early: Early-bird price NT$499 for people on the list
vt_p1_d: For one person, on your Macs. Dictation into any app, transcripts of recordings, your own words and fixes.
vt_p2_d: For offices that cannot send speech to the cloud: law firms, clinics, finance, government work. Team licences by the year on request.
vt_price_cmp: For comparison, cloud dictation subscriptions cost around NT$480 a month — and upload your voice to do it.
vt_q1_a: Only once, to download the language files: about 2.5 GB for Chinese (English included), about 0.9 GB for English alone. After that VoiceTecx works fully offline — on a plane, in a meeting room, anywhere.
vt_q2: Which apps does it work in?
vt_q2_a: Any app with a text cursor: LINE, Word, Mail, Notes, Slack, your browser. Press your shortcut, speak, and the text appears where you are typing.
vt_q3_a: A Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later. Memory: 16 GB minimum, 24 GB good, 32 GB best. Intel Macs are not supported. Speed was measured on an M5; older Macs are slower, and VoiceTecx shows its estimate for long files.
vt_q4: How is it better than the dictation built into macOS?
vt_q4_a: On our test it made about 44% fewer character mistakes in Taiwan Mandarin, writes punctuation as you speak, spells English names and your own words correctly, and learns from the fixes you make.
vt_q5: Which computers does VoiceTecx run on?
vt_q5_a: VoiceTecx is made exclusively for the Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and tuned for it, so everything runs on your Mac, fast and fully offline.
vt_q6: Can my company get an invoice?
vt_q6_a: Yes. Business licences come with a Taiwan e-invoice (電子發票). Ask us about licences for a team.
vt_q7_a: VoiceTecx builds on open models — Breeze-ASR-25 by MediaTek Research (Apache 2.0) and Whisper large-v3-turbo by OpenAI (MIT), run with whisper.cpp (MIT) — combined and tuned by TECXMATE for the way Taiwan writes.
vt_download_note: Free beta · macOS 14 or later · Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) · 6 MB, then the language files in the app
vt_c3_title: Time to text after you stop
vt_modes_lead: Pick one for your Mac and your work. Every mode is tested on the same recordings.
vt_s_lead: Taiwan's own formats and names, long dictations, and recordings. The engines hear the words; VoiceTecx writes them the way Taiwan writes.
vt_s_zero_d: on 172,221 passages of correct Chinese text: a name is changed only when the sentence says it is a place or an agency.
vt_s_scale_lead: Built-in lists from official open data, each tested on real text before it ships.
vt_s_n_stations: rail, high-speed rail and MRT stations
vt_s_fix_d: 350 of 352, with 0 changed to a wrong name. Simulated mishearings, with the county named before the district.
vt_s_steps_title: False changes on correct text, version by version
vt_s_steps_lead: Each rule was rewritten until it changed nothing that was already right.
vt_s_live_lead: VoiceTecx writes each finished part while you keep talking, so a long dictation is ready sooner.
vt_s_live_scale: 5 dictations of 31–51 s, seconds, shorter is better
vt_s_live_note: In testing, off by default. One speaker, on our tests, M5 MacBook Pro on power. Character errors 7.2 → 7.5 per 100: 4 of the 5 dictations came out the same.
vt_s_file_lead: Drop in a recording or a video and get a transcript with times, or subtitles. macOS dictation only listens to the microphone.
vt_s_file_note: A capability, not a benchmark: we have not published speed or accuracy numbers for files yet.
